description:
Free. What a call to a SalesMap tool is expected to cost, before running it, against what the workspace can spend now (credits and limits). Not a charge: the most the call can charge, which it reserves (or its max_usd); it is charged per result returned, never more. When `fits` is false, `shortfallUsd` says how much more credit is needed and `topUp` is the link.
Use when: "how much will this cost", "can I afford 20 accounts", "what would a discover for my site cost".
Skip when: the user wants their balance or limits without a call in mind. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.
